in_marathi.name: Padmalochan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Padmalochan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Padma: Lotus, Lochana: Face. This name is derived from the Hindu deity Vishnu, who is often depicted with a lotus flower on his navel and four arms, each holding a symbol. The name Padmalochan signifies one who possesses a radiant, lotus-like face and embodies the divine qualities of love, compassion, and power.
